titulo.alumno:
«Причастный оборот или придаточное»
Participle phrase or relative clause

intro: The participle condenses information and usually belongs to written register; который builds a more explicit subordinate clause.

piezas.titulo: The participle condenses information and usually belongs to written register; который builds a more explicit subordinate clause.
texto: The participle condenses information and usually belongs to written register; который builds a more explicit subordinate clause.
Choose according to clarity and register; the case of который depends on its role in the subordinate clause.

frases.estudio: Доклад, подготовленный комиссией, опубликован на сайте.
frases.alumno: The report, prepared by the commission, was published on the website.

frases.estudio: Доклад, который подготовила комиссия, опубликован на сайте.
frases.alumno: The report that the commission prepared was published on the website.

pregunta.texto: Which alternative uses an explicit subordinate clause?

opciones.explicacion: Который introduces a relative clause with a conjugated verb.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Доклад, подготовленный комиссией, опубликован на сайте.»

frase.texto: Доклад, подготовленный комиссией, опубликован на сайте.

opciones.texto: The report, prepared by the commission, was published on the website.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The report that the commission prepared was published on the website.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Доклад, который подготовила комиссия, опубликован на сайте

piezas.traduccion: The report that the commission prepared was published on the website.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
